text:
kat: Starting controlled deploy v2.8.0 to us-west-2 at 23:45 PT. We'll gate the new flag 'route-v4' across tiny cohorts. Change window 23:45-00:45 PT. @deploy-bot kick it off.

deploy-bot: Scheduled D-111211 by kat for 23:45 PT. Ramp plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 7m holds. Telemetry enabled.

sam: Rollback criteria?

kat: Abort if 5m error rate >1.6x baseline OR sustained p95 >380ms OR customer 5xx >=0.5%. Also abort if token throughput >2.2x cohort forecast. On abort: `deploy-bot abort D-111211` then `scripts/pin_version.sh router v2.7.9` and `scripts/disable_flag.sh route-v4`.

alex: Add shard-exclude flow: if only one shard misbehaves, use `flags.exclude_shards=[id]` then monitor 5m before wider rollback.

maria: I'll watch latency and autoscale. ops-bot, mute non-critical alerts for 1h.

ops-bot: Muting alert group "dev-noise" 60m from 23:40 PT. Critical alerts still sent.

kat: Owners: I own steps 1-2. Alex owns steps 3-4. Sam final approve for 100%. QA-bot will run quick smoke after each cohort flip.

qa-bot: Running smoke check after step flips. Will post pass/fail.

deploy-bot: Executing step 1 -> cohort=dev-canary (1%). Command: `scripts/rollout_toggle.sh route-v4 dev-canary true`.

qa-bot: Step1 smoke PASS. Minor p50 increase +3ms.

maria: +5m: metrics stable. Proceeding to step 2 in 90s.

deploy-bot: Step 2 -> cohort=internal-beta (5%) at 23:54:12. Holding 7m.

alex: Watch shard s-3 during step 2, past flakiness there. If s-3 errors, try exclude.

maria: +3m into step2: transient p95 blip to 310ms for 45s, recovered. No 5xx uptick.

kat: proceed to step3 after hold.

deploy-bot: Starting step 3 -> cohort=regional-na (20%). Reducing cache-ttl to 30s for this step.

maria: At +2m of step3 p95 trending up to 360ms. I'm pausing progress and flagging alex.

alex: I'm looking. It's concentrated on shard s-3. Applying exclude_shards=[s-3] now and monitoring.

deploy-bot: Applied flags.exclude_shards=[s-3] for cohort=regional-na. Telemetry tagged step=3 action=partial-exclude.

qa-bot: Post-exclude smoke PASS. p95 back down to baseline.

kat: Good mitigation. We'll hold for the remainder of the 7m then re-evaluate moving to 60%. If another shard breaks, full abort.

sam: Reminder: use `deploy-bot abort D-111211` for emergency and `scripts/pin_version.sh router v2.7.9` to pin. Keep support notified.

ops-bot: Change window ends 00:45 PT. Auto-rollback set at 00:50 PT if final not confirmed.

alex: After hold looks stable. Proceed to step4 -> 60% with note to keep s-3 excluded for 10m post-60%.

deploy-bot: Step4 executed -> cohort=global-50 (60%) at 00:12:01. flags.exclude_shards=[s-3] applied.

maria: +5m after step4: metrics OK, autoscale handled load on s-11 only. No customer impact.

kat: Sam, handing to you for final enable in 10m. If you see anything, abort.

sam: Taking handoff. Final check in 8m then full enable. Release note: "v2.8.0: routing optimizations; staged enable of route-v4 with shard exclusion fallback. Rollback criteria in eng-releases."

ops-bot: Final monitor time window 30m starting 00:20 PT.

sam: All good at final check. Proceeding to full enable and clearing exclude_shards.

deploy-bot: Full enable at 00:28:10 - route-v4=true for 100%. Removed flags.exclude_shards. tags: D-111211 step=5 cohort=all

qa-bot: Final smoke PASS +15m. No regressions detected.

maria: Post-deploy metrics steady. Closing thread unless someone reopens.

kat: Thanks all. I'll push a short ops+support note summarizing: rollback triggers, shard-exclude procedure, and runbook commands.

(End of thread)
